_comment: Checked-in copy of the identifiers a legacy_content disposition may cite as its reference: inventory_routes are the route ids of the Phase 1 optimization-channel inventory (INVENTORY-v1.md section 1); inventory_rows maps each route to the number of its field rows in section 2, so 'INV S5-5' names the 5th field row of S5 and must satisfy 1 <= 5 <= inventory_rows['S5']; design_v2_2_sections are the section numbers of design v2.2. Used by scripts/content_class_manifest.py reference validation.
